key_findings: Quercetin alleviated KOA pain in DMM mice and PGE2-stimulated DRG neurons by inhibiting cGAS/STING and downstream VEGFA/VEGFR1 signalling.
STING activation with SR-717 reversed quercetin's antinociceptive effects.
